name: Nekonade Distortion Ren'ai Jishou no Dead End
original_name: 猫撫ディストーション 恋愛事象のデッドエンド
source:
This is a crowdfunded fandisc for Nekonade Distortion. One day, Tatsuki’s childhood friend Yuzu turned into his little sister “Kotoko”. When he went to his mother Shikiko for advice, she was “Kotoko” as well. Then his older sister Yui showed up in front of him… as “Kotoko”. Everyone that he knew had turned into “Kotoko” on the inside.

What exactly had happened?! What should I do?!

“Nii-san, this is the DEAD END world.”

“Soon, you will become me as well.”

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2015/05/17/may-2015-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
这是Nekonade Distortion的众筹同人光盘。有一天，辰希的青梅竹马柚子变成了他的妹妹“琴子”。当他向母亲志纪子寻求建议时，她也是“琴子”。然后他的姐姐唯以“琴子”的身份出现在他面前。他认识的每个人的内心都变成了“Kotoko”。

究竟发生了什么？我应该怎么办？！

“哥哥，这里是DEAD END世界。”

“很快，你也会成为我。”

[来自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2015/05/17/may-2015-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
